evidence_scope: Fixed-weight synthetic navigation across declared size/topology conditions. Raw policy, legal-action masking and observed-map planning are separate controls. Observed-map planning is engineered episodic assistance from local observations and public grid size; map_without_policy removes the learned tie-break prior. Zero masked/planned collisions follow legal filtering. Each variant and world starts with empty controller memory; no teacher actions or learning are used. The shortest-path oracle has privileged full-map access. All controls share one frozen model, and no-graft/no-recurrence are inference interventions rather than separately trained models. Seeds are paired across conditions and variants; conditions are correlated, not independent replications. Small arenas may share geometry across topology labels. Declared seeds do not prove unseen training worlds. No biological advantage, raw neural capability gain or pretrained language improvement is established. No checkpoint promotion is performed.
